'Your next attack this turn gets +2{p}. The crowd boos you. Go again' -- Go again is printed and unconditional, deliberately not authored and not declared conditional.

CROWD_BOO defaults to the CONTROLLER, which is what 'boos YOU' means; the opponent-facing form needs an explicit player. It routes through ability_keywords.effect_crowd_boos -> effect_keywords.boo (CR 8.5.57), so replacement effects and every card that reads the booed state see it -- a SET_FLAG here would be invisible to both.

MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK with no filter is right: the text says 'your next attack', unqualified.
